title: Locked final test of the selected single-pass retrieval baseline
researchQuestion: Does the validation-selected single-pass retrieval configuration retain strong canonical-evidence retrieval and abstention on the untouched v4 test split?
hypothesis: The selected baseline generalizes to the locked test split with high Recall@4, MRR, and nDCG@4 while producing at most one false positive among twelve unanswerable cases.

testSplit.name: test
testSplit.executionPolicy: Execute exactly once after this protocol and the runner are committed. A cache-preserving recovery is allowed only for a technical failure before aggregate metrics are revealed.

approvalProvenance.interpretation: The benchmark is an AI-assisted provisional reference and must not be described as independently human-validated.

metrics.uncertainty: Report Wilson 95% intervals for full-coverage, any-hit, and unanswerable false-positive proportions.

frozenReplicationChecks.interpretation: These are preregistered replication guardrails, not tuning targets. A failed check does not authorize parameter changes or a rerun.

prohibitedAfterExecution: changing chunks, embedding model, metadata filter, reranker, or agentic setting
excluding cases because of their outcomes
rerunning a completed test to obtain better metrics
limitations: Only twelve answerable and twelve unanswerable cases are available, so uncertainty intervals will be wide.
Approval labels remain pending confirmation and were not produced by an independent second reviewer.
This verifies retrieval only; answer-generation quality is outside this experiment.
